claimExpiredInsuranceNFT(uint256[],addre.details: This function doesn't revert if one of the NFTs isn't claimable yet. This is done to prevent situations in which multiple NFTs can't be claimed because of one not being claimable yet

params._toClaim: The indexes of the NFTs to claim

params.calldatas: The data to pass in each call
params.values: The ETH value for each call

liquidate(uint256[],address).details: This function doesn't revert if one of the positions is not liquidatable. This is done to prevent situations in which multiple positions can't be liquidated because of one not liquidatable position. It reverts on insufficient balance.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimExpiredInsuranceNFT(uint256[],addre.notice: Allows any address to claim NFTs from multiple expired insurance postions at once. The liquidated NFTs are sent to the DAO This function can be called by anyone, however the address calling it doesn't get any PUSd/NFT as everything is sent to the owner of this contract

doCalls(address[],bytes[],uint256[]).notice: Allows the DAO to perform multiple calls using this contract (recovering funds/NFTs stuck in this contract)

liquidate(uint256[],address).notice: Allows any address to liquidate multiple positions at once. It assumes enough PUSD is in the contract. The liquidated NFTs are sent to the DAO. This function can be called by anyone, however the address calling it doesn't get any PUSd/NFT as everything is sent to the owner of this contract

setTrustedNFTVault(address,bool).notice: Allows the DAO to set an address as a trusted NFTVault

userdoc.notice: Liquidator contract that allows liquidator bots to liquidate positions without holding any PUSd/NFTs. It's only meant to be used by DAO bots. The liquidated NFTs are sent to the DAO
